astrophysical_parameters_targets.query: SELECT * FROM gaiadr3.astrophysical_parameters WHERE source_id IN (4792202879700135040,4673750877131752832,1346023547769345792)

cone90_270573718.query: SELECT source_id, ra, dec, parallax, parallax_error, pmra, pmdec, phot_g_mean_mag, phot_bp_mean_mag, phot_rp_mean_mag, bp_rp, ruwe, ipd_frac_multi_peak, ipd_frac_odd_win, ipd_gof_harmonic_amplitude, visibility_periods_used, astrometric_params_solved, phot_variable_flag, has_epoch_photometry, has_xp_continuous, has_rvs, radial_velocity, non_single_star, duplicated_source, phot_bp_rp_excess_factor, DISTANCE(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), POINT('ICRS', 86.723128722, -52.816180857))*3600.0 AS sep_arcsec FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 86.723128722, -52.816180857, 0.0250000000)) ORDER BY sep_arcsec
